plugins.name: daily-exec-briefing-um7sa
plugins.description: Turns your executive's Outlook day into a single one-page briefing you can read in 90 seconds, with a snapshot, agenda, external guest flags and decisions needed for every real meeting. You get a Claude Doc back, plus an optional unsent email draft.

plugins.name: daily-meeting-briefing-pack-9d1h6
plugins.description: Every weekday morning it reviews today's calendar, skips internal and non-meeting blocks, and writes a one-page briefing for each meeting that involves outside attendees. Finished briefings land in a Drive folder, named by date and meeting title.

plugins.name: downloads-folder-tidy-and-file-renamer-pxbc2
plugins.description: Cleans up a messy downloads folder by renaming loose files to a consistent YYYY.MM.DD - Description format and sorting them into Receipts, Artwork Proofs, or Documents. You get a tidy, searchable folder without touching a thing.

plugins.name: travel-confirmations-to-calendar-bp7k4
plugins.description: A scheduled weekday agent that finds new booking confirmations in Gmail and turns every one into a complete calendar event: flights leg by leg with check-in reminders, hotels marked Free so they never block the calendar, rental cars, and restaurant reservations. Each confirmation document is filed into a tidy Drive trip folder and attached to its event, and every run ends with a written report of what was created, skipped, or needs your eyes.
